verses.text: As God's fellow workers, we beg you: do not let the grace you received from God be wasted.
God says, "At the right time I listened to you. On the day of saving I helped you." Listen! Now is the right time. Today is the day of saving.
We try not to put anything in anyone's way, so that no one can find fault with our work.
Instead, in everything we show that we are God's servants. We keep going through troubles, hard times and suffering.
We have been beaten and put in prison. We have faced angry crowds. We have worked hard, gone without sleep and gone without food.
We show it by being pure, by knowing the truth, by being patient and kind, by the Holy Spirit, and by real love.
We show it by speaking the truth and by God's power. We use right living as our weapons, in the right hand and in the left.
Sometimes people honour us, and sometimes they shame us. Sometimes they speak badly of us, and sometimes well. They call us liars, but we tell the truth.
They treat us as unknown, but we are well known. We seem to be dying, but look, we live on. We are beaten, but not killed.
We are sad, but always full of joy. We are poor, but we make many people rich. We have nothing, but we own everything.
People of Corinth, we have spoken openly to you. Our hearts are wide open to you.
We are not holding back our love from you, but you are holding back your love from us.
I speak to you as my children. Open your hearts wide to us in return.
Do not join yourselves with people who do not believe. What do right and wrong have in common? Can light and darkness share anything?
How can Christ agree with the devil? What does a believer share with someone who does not believe?
How can God's temple agree with idols? We are the temple of the living God. As God has said, "I will live with them and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people."
So the Lord says, "Come out from among them and be separate. Touch nothing unclean, and I will welcome you.
I will be your Father, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord All-Powerful."
